prompts.character_sheet_v1: Use case: illustration-story. Asset: production character sheet for a Vietnamese household technology explainer channel. Input image is identity and illustration-style reference, not an edit target. Create a crisp large SQUARE 2x2 character sheet on genuinely transparent background, four separated identical-sized full-body poses, one per quadrant, generous empty gutters, no border. Same fictional Vietnamese man age 45–50 as reference: swept black hair with gray temples, round dark glasses, warm face, dark indigo work shirt with amber collar/pocket piping over white undershirt, dark trousers, simple dark shoes. Preserve facial identity and age in ALL poses. Top-left: friendly explainer, left hand open toward viewer's right. Top-right: surprised raised eyebrows, holds one generic unbranded small white Wi-Fi router with two antennae at waist; other palm open. Bottom-left: thoughtful, one hand under chin, other relaxed. Bottom-right: holds a blank-screen smartphone in one hand, points at it with other, curious expression. Polished editorial cartoon, warm shading and clean confident outlines matching reference, readable natural anatomy and five fingers when visible, objects held coherently. Full bodies including shoes and hands inside each quadrant with equal scale. No words, no numbers, no typography, no watermark, no badge, no logo, no circular background. Intended compositing over cream backgrounds; keep actual alpha.
prompts.apartment_v1: Use case: illustration-story. Asset: wide 16:9 educational background illustration for a Vietnamese household Wi-Fi explainer. Warm modern modest Vietnamese apartment cutaway, clearly divided into living room on LEFT and bedroom on RIGHT, a thick central wall and open doorway between rooms. Clean three-quarter dollhouse perspective, subtle polished editorial-cartoon style, precise simple readable objects. Living room: sofa, low table, and an unbranded WHITE router with TWO upright antennas sitting on a small open waist-high shelf near the inner left side. Bedroom: bed, side table, plain wardrobe away from doorway, an unbranded smartphone with completely blank gray screen on the bedside table. Daylight, warm cream walls, indigo and muted teal accents, amber details. Entire apartment fits safely inside frame with generous outer margins, simple neutral background. No people. No wires across walking paths. Router and smartphone are illustrative props with no technical claims. Absolutely NO text, lettering, numbers, logos, watermark, Wi-Fi signal waves, arrows, coverage heatmaps or graphs; all explanatory overlays will be added in code. Wide landscape composition.
